LanguageData.AWL_EnableTheAmmoSystem: When checked, the ammunition system is enabled.
LanguageData.AWL_EnableBackupAmmoSystemDesc: When checked, some weapons will need to be loaded by resources.
LanguageData.AWL_BackupAmmoMultipilerLabel: Global multiplier for backup ammo capacity
LanguageData.AWL_BackupAmmoMultipilerDesc: The backup ammo capacity limit of all weapons using the backup ammo system will be multiplied by this value.
LanguageData.AWL_OnlyShowAmmoGizmoWhenSelectedOneThin: Ammunition gizmo is displayed only when a pawn is selected
Ammunition gizmo is displayed only when a pawn is selected.
LanguageData.AWL_RandomWeaponModeForNonPlayerPawnLabe: Non-player controled pawn randomly switch weapon modes
LanguageData.AWL_RandomWeaponModeForNonPlayerPawnDesc: After activation, if a controled pawn is equipped with weapons of multiple modes, it will automatically switch to one of the modes.\n\nWhen turned off, only the default mode is used.
